1.name: House of Leaves Wallpaper
1.desc: I wanted a wallpaper of the cover of house of leaves, but I couldn't find any decent scans, so I decided to remake it myself.

2.name: Artwork
2.desc: This is the first full illustration I did since attempting to get back into drawing. It's pretty rough, given both my rustiness and my lack of experience working with a tablet (most of my drawing was on paper with pencil/pen). I'm still happy I was able to finish it though, however rough it may be.

3.name: Chibi Draco Centauros
3.desc: When I worked as a camp counsellor, I used to doodle a lot of chibi dracos like this while on bathroom watch. Sometimes I think its the only thing that got me through that job.
